canonical_fill.title: Delivery status – Supplier Core Services
canonical_fill.purpose: Fill-to-mark capacity and multi-sprint layout reference

legacy_ai_rulebook.note: Mode 'ai' retained for backward compatibility only. Use hybrid full mode.

rules.name: Title format
rules.description: Slide title must follow: Delivery status – {Service Name}

rules.name: Title position
rules.description: Top-left title placeholder geometry from G10X

rules.name: Highlights header font
rules.description: Manrope Bold 14pt, white on dark maroon background

rules.name: Status columns
rules.description: Overall status (orange), Last week / This week (green) present on main delivery slides

paragraph_hierarchy.description: Optional project label (e.g. SPUR) — bold, no bullet

paragraph_hierarchy.bold_prefix_text: Sprint name and status through first comma
paragraph_hierarchy.format: Sprint – {Name}, {Status} ({Dates}) Stories (Total – N, Done – X, In-review – Y, In-progress – Z)

paragraph_hierarchy.description: Current week sprint status — round bullet •
Story category headers — ONLY the G10X solid right-pointing arrowhead bullet (Wingdings Ø). No other bullet style is allowed.
paragraph_hierarchy.bullet_note: PowerPoint stores buChar Ø with buFont Wingdings. Together they render as the black right-pointing arrowhead from the G10X template. Using Ø without Wingdings, or any other character (•, -, ₋, ▶, ➤, →), is INVALID.
paragraph_hierarchy.forbidden_bullet_note: Round bullets are for sprint lines; dashes are for story items; Unicode triangles/arrows are NOT substitutes.
patterns: Stories released for partner review – {N} stories

paragraph_hierarchy.description: Individual story lines — dash bullet ₋ or -, regular weight, aligned with current-week indent (NOT with category arrow)
Exactly one blank paragraph between sprint blocks

spacing_rules.name: Category to first story
spacing_rules.description: NO blank line between category header and first story bullet

spacing_rules.name: Story to story
spacing_rules.description: Single line spacing within a story list — template uses fixed 16pt line height (a:lnSpc/a:spcPts val=1600) for 12pt body text

spacing_rules.name: Between sprint blocks
spacing_rules.description: Visual separation between sprint blocks — template uses 0–1 blank lines depending on content. Do NOT require a fixed blank-line count; only flag when sprint blocks appear merged or excessively separated.

space_utilization.description: Deprecated for deterministic evaluation — use measured layout bands instead of main vs contd labels.
space_utilization.notes: Deterministic rules use hl_waste_dense_fill_max_in and hl_waste_sparse_ka_max_in from template_layout_thresholds.json. Slide type (is_contd) must not change thresholds.

sparse_sizing.description: Internal HL slack below last bullet (hl_waste_below_text_in). Dense-fill slides: up to ~0.12 in is normal padding. Sparse HL+KA slides may have up to ~1.05 in by design. Flag HL-SIZE-01 / CONT-SPARSE-01 only above calibrated bands in template_layout_thresholds.json.
sparse_sizing.notes: Overlap/clipping is HL-OVERFLOW-01 / KA-OVERLAP-01, not HL-SIZE-01

rules.name: KA header text
rules.description: Header row text: Key activities for next week

rules.name: KA project grouping
rules.description: Optional bold project sub-headers with round bullet items below

placement_rules.name: KA after Highlights
placement_rules.description: Key Activities must only appear after Highlights content is complete on that slide
placement_rules.forbidden: KA on same slide while Highlights has large unused area and overflow content on contd

placement_rules.name: HL to KA tab spacing
placement_rules.description: Spacing between HL table bottom border and KA header (hl_ka_gap_in — the double-arrow gap). Calibrated target 0.3111 in (~2 body lines). Flag when hl_ka_gap_in > 0.3311 in.

placement_rules.name: KA-only contd slide
placement_rules.description: When main slide is full of Highlights, KA may move to (Contd...) with no Highlights table. layout_type ka_only_contd is VALID — do NOT flag missing HL tab or HL-UTIL-01.

placement_rules.name: KA on main when space permits
placement_rules.description: When Highlights text ends well above the HL table bottom and KA fits within the footer safe zone (~6.29 in), Key Activities MUST stay on the main slide — do not create a KA-only (Contd...) slide
placement_rules.forbidden: KA-only (Contd...) when main slide has enough vertical space below sparse Highlights

sparse_sizing.description: When Key Activities has few items, shrink the KA table to content height — do not leave a large empty area below the last bullet

layout_principles.content_agnostic_note: All layout rules are content-relative formulas. NEVER pass or fail a slide by comparing it to a named reference slide (e.g. Cost Core, Supplier). The same rules apply to every service; only content volume changes box heights and whether (Contd...) is needed.

dynamic_sizing.sparse: Shrink HL and KA gray content boxes to rendered text + standard padding. White space at the bottom of the slide is valid and preferred over stretched boxes.
dynamic_sizing.dense: Expand HL up to the available column budget (footer safe zone) when content requires it.

hl_ka_spacing.description: HL–KA tab spacing = hl_ka_gap_in (HL table bottom to KA header). Calibrated target 0.3111 in, max 0.3311 in. Minimum text_ka_clearance_in >= 0.15 in (no merge). Internal HL slack uses dense-fill vs sparse HL+KA bands (see template_layout_thresholds.json).

footer_boundary.description: Footer rule applies to RENDERED TEXT, not table borders. Dense HL-only slides may extend the table toward the dotted line. Fail GEO-02 only when estimated_text_bottom_in or ka_rendered_text_bottom_in enters the footer zone.

contd_decision_tree.condition: HL + KA fit in footer zone with text clearance >= 0.15 in
HL sparse with room below text and KA fits in footer zone
HL dense (utilization ≥ 85%) and KA cannot fit below HL on main within footer
contd_decision_tree.outcome: HL-only or HL-full main + KA-only (Contd...) — valid Supplier/Pharmacy pattern

contd_decision_tree.condition: HL dense, fills column, KA does not fit below HL on main
HL content exceeds main column capacity
layout_type ka_only_contd — HL finished on prior slide, only KA remains
contd_decision_tree.outcome: Valid — do NOT flag missing HL (KA-PLC-03)

contd_decision_tree.condition: (Contd...) slide has few bullets in oversized HL box

overlap_rules.text_to_ka: Rendered HL text must not intrude into KA (text_ka_clearance_in >= 0.15 in)
overlap_rules.hl_text_inside_table: HL text must not extend below the HL table border (hl_text_overflow_in == 0)
overlap_rules.footer_content: Rendered HL/KA text must not enter footer zone (estimated_text_bottom_in, ka_rendered_text_bottom_in <= 6.29 in)

on_slide_ka.description: Main slide with both Highlights and Key Activities when content fits in footer zone
on_slide_ka.hl_sizing: Sparse: shrink HL to text; dense: expand toward KA anchor
on_slide_ka.ka_placement: Directly below HL with ~2 body lines between table borders (~0.31 in)

hl_only_main.description: Main slide with only Highlights when HL is dense and KA moves to (Contd...)
hl_only_main.hl_sizing: Expand HL to fill column up to footer safe zone

contd_hl_ka.description: Continuation slide with both HL overflow and KA when both fit on contd
contd_hl_ka.hl_sizing: Shrink when sparse; expand when dense

ka_contd_only.description: Continuation slide with only Key Activities when main is HL-full
ka_contd_only.ka_sizing: Shrink KA table to item count

rules.name: Content cell top-align
rules.description: Highlights content cell (row 2) text is top-aligned, not vertically centered

rules.name: Footer safe zone
rules.description: KA bottom must not extend below ~6.29 in. Dense HL-only main may extend to ~6.55 in when utilization >= 85%.

rules.name: Contd title suffix
rules.description: Continuation slides append (Contd…) to service title

rules.name: No repeated category header
rules.description: When continuing same story bucket from previous slide, do NOT repeat category header (e.g. Stories completed this week)

rules.name: No repeated sprint block
rules.description: When continuing mid-sprint, do NOT repeat sprint line or Current week sprint status

rules.name: New sprint on contd
rules.description: A new sprint block on contd MUST include full sprint line + current week + category headers

rules.name: No sparse contd
rules.description: (Contd...) slides must not have large empty Highlights area when only a few bullets present

repair_instructions.for_model: You are a G10X WSR delivery-status deck layout repair planner. Follow layout_principles (content-agnostic — never compare to named reference slides). Given extracted slide metrics and deterministic violations, return a FixPlan JSON with ONLY whitelisted actions. Prefer layout_repair and in-place geometry fixes before rebuild_with_hints. Map: HL-SIZE-01/KA-SIZE-01/CONT-SPARSE-01/KA-PLC-01/KA-PLC-02/KA-OVERLAP-01 → layout_repair; KA-PLC-04 → layout_repair + rebuild if needed; TITLE-01 → fix_title_en_dash; HL-SPC-01 → remove_category_story_blanks; HL-SPC-03 → remove_extra_sprint_blanks; GEO-02 → layout_repair or rebuild.

fixes.action: reflow_hl_ka | fix_category_bullets | remove_extra_sprint_blanks | shrink_sparse_hl | layout_repair | fix_title_en_dash | rebuild_with_hints
fixes.service_title: string (service name without Delivery status prefix)

evaluation_architecture.principle: Deterministic geometry is the source of truth. AI evaluates subjective visual quality only.

evaluation_instructions.note: Legacy AI rulebook auditor (mode 'ai'). Geometry rules are enforced deterministically in v2.0.
evaluation_instructions.for_model: DEPRECATED — use visual quality reviewer for subjective assessment. Deterministic code enforces all measurable layout rules.
